title: New Fossil Confirms a Human Ancestor Appeared 200,000 Years Earlier Than Expected
caption:
New fossil evidence from South Africa pushes the emergence of Homo erectus back by roughly 200,000 years. The site reveals our early ancestors were heavily outnumbered by rival hominins sharing the exact same landscape.

Source: Sciencealert - New Fossil Confirms a Human Ancestor Appeared 200,000 Years Earlier Than Expected
